left:
Create ONE full-body game sprite, a very careful animation-frame edit of the attached ORIGINAL standing reference, not a redesign. Same young adult Ivan, same realistic adult head-to-body ratio, same head size, same torso width, limbs and boots equal thickness, same hair, scarf, olive coat, belt, trousers, backpack, camera elevation and three-quarter rear viewing angle. Preserve the original upper-body silhouette almost exactly. Keep original neutral warm illumination and muted exposure: no highlights or new rim light. Match original material colors. Do not enlarge head, hands or coat. Keep the same framing and top-of-head location, full body visible with margin. Transparent background. Feet travel along two parallel walking tracks in the direction his face points, never sideways, never bow-legged or crossing. A modest normal walk, not running or marching. The attachment is the ONLY identity and proportion source. Output just one character, no diagrams, text, extra people or contact sheet.
POSE: walking away diagonally towards the UPPER LEFT of the image. We need the OPPOSITE of a pose with the prominent near boot trailing behind. Identify the NEAR leg in the reference: its thigh is beneath the visible sleeve on the LEFT side of the image; its shin and boot occupy the LOWER LEFT of the standing figure. This SAME near leg now reaches FORWARD towards upper-left, knee softly extended, heel contacting ground, toe pointing along travel towards upper-left. Its boot moves UP and slightly LEFT from its standing location. Follow the whole near hip-knee-ankle chain into this reaching boot. The farther leg, attached beneath the backpack on the RIGHT side of the picture, now trails BACK towards lower-right: knee slightly flexed, heel raised, toe finishing push-off, its boot moves DOWN and slightly RIGHT from standing. The near leading boot must not remain the bottommost foot: the far trailing boot reaches at least as low on the canvas. Keep the near foot visibly ahead along the diagonal track, not flared sideways. Moderate stride (about one boot-length forward and one boot-length backward from standing), knees track straight. Near arm swings slightly backward along lower-right, far arm slightly forward along upper-left, very small swing with head and chest stable. This is ONE frame of near-leg-forward ground contact.
